summary: Round 14 full backend + frontend E2E. Admin password rotation, admin audit log writes/reads, /admin/metrics.recent_activity, R2 scan key helper, StatsStrip, scroll-aware navbar all verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: audit_record is fire-and-forget (try/except swallow) per design — verified no crashes when writes happen even if Mongo audit insert fails. Good defensive practice.
Token field in /api/admin-auth/login response is 'access_token' (not 'token'). Frontend AdminLogin already reads correctly via api client; documented in test fixture.
Country PATCH model does not include is_active in CountryPatch — only no_visa, processing_days, etc. Tests now toggle no_visa to ensure diff is recorded.
Admin audit panel renders correctly with red/green diff chips and action icons (Update, Create, Delete). UI shows admin email + entity + entity_id + per-field before→after.
